'''Ellis Ruger''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic Marshall|Marshall]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], he was [[Invasion of Belsavis|killed]] by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] that was sent to end his activities against the Empire. When word of Ruger's [[Death/Legends|death]] reached the [[Imperial Guard]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Calum]] rewarded the Imperial who had slain the Marshall.

==Behind the scenes==
{{GameDS}}
Ellis is a NPC character in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. His fate can be decided two ways: Execute him with Warden [[Graal]] witnessing through a hologram (dark side option) or ransom him and demand that he be relieved of duty, to which Graal complies (light side option).
